name: Lyth
source:
Lyth, the nameless. Her title comes from her being a war orphan, and she was given shelter in the place she was born. Possibly as an the aftereffect of her experience, Lyth can only see the world in monochrome. She has a three-pronged tail, a feature very rare among members of the Dog race.

She may look delicate at first glance, but she is in fact very skilled at espionage activities that make use of her slight physique.
However, she is a bit bothered by the fact that her delicate body isn't fit for child-rearing. Just a bit. Really, just a bit. Her long scarf is her trademark. She's a bit of a bashful girl, and has a tendency to hide her face when she's troubled and doesn't know what to do.

[From Frontwing's [url=https://www.facebook.com/FrontwingINT/photos/a.1633584283526141.1073741829.1633299420221294/1706281126256456/?type=3]official Facebook page[/url]]
